Ashlar 0.3.0 consumer application","user":{"login":"IanFrelinger","id":16062048,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjE2MDYyMDQ4","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/16062048?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/IanFrelinger/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"labels":[],"state":"open","locked":false,"assignees":[],"milestone":null,"comments":0,"created_at":"2026-10-24T03:19:42Z","updated_at":"2026-10-24T03:34:30Z","closed_at":null,"assignee":null,"author_association":"OWNER","active_lock_reason":null,"draft":false,"pull_request":{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pulls/844","html_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/844","diff_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/844.diff","patch_url":"https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/844.patch","merged_at":null},"body":" ## What This Is A command-line tool that answers: **"What is blocking this PR or release?"** This is a **consumer application** built on **Ashlar 0.3.0** packages from nuget.org, demonstrating real-world usage patterns. This is **not part of Ashlar core** — it lives as a separate consumer application in `/pr-blocker-assistant/`. ## What It Does Given a GitHub PR URL or release tag: - ✅ Gathers commit status and check runs - ✅ Reviews approval status and change requests - ✅ Identifies merge conflicts - ✅ Checks release artifacts and draft status - ✅ Returns concise summary with evidence links ## Architecture **Pure consumer** of Ashlar 0.3.0: - Uses published packages from nuget.org only (no local dependencies) - Built on `Ashlar.Hosting.Bundle` v0.3.0 - Implements a custom brick (`PrBlockerBrick`) using `Ashlar.Authoring` - Simple CLI host that executes the brick and displays results ## How to Build and Test ### Prerequisites - .NET 10 SDK (or .NET 8) - Optional: GitHub personal access token ### Build ```bash cd pr-blocker-assistant dotnet restore --configfile nuget.config dotnet build ``` ### Run ```bash # Basic usage dotnet run --project src/PrBlocker.CLI -- https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 # With GitHub token (recommended for higher rate limits) export GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your_token_here dotnet run --project src/PrBlocker.CLI -- https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/pull/12345 # Or use the test script ./test-real-pr.sh https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/pull/17796 ``` ## Documentation - **[README.md](pr-blocker-assistant/README.md)** - Overview and quick start - **[QUICKSTART.md](pr-blocker-assistant/QUICKSTART.md)** - Detailed installation and usage guide - **[TESTING_WORKFLOW.md](pr-blocker-assistant/TESTING_WORKFLOW.md)** - 🆕 Complete guide for Phase 2 testing - **[USAGE_LOG.md](pr-blocker-assistant/USAGE_LOG.md)** - 🆕 Template for tracking 10 real-world assessments - **[PROJECT_SUMMARY.md](pr-blocker-assistant/PROJECT_SUMMARY.md)** - Architecture and design decisions - **[EXAMPLE_OUTPUT.md](pr-blocker-assistant/EXAMPLE_OUTPUT.md)** - Sample outputs from different scenarios - **[FINDINGS.md](pr-blocker-assistant/FINDINGS.md)** - Framework observations and recommendations ## What This Demonstrates ### Ashlar Consumer Patterns 1. **Package consumption**: Clean consumption of `Ashlar.Hosting.Bundle` 0.3.0 from nuget.org 2. **Brick authoring**: Custom brick implementation using `DomainBrick` 3. **Host integration**: Minimal host setup with `AddAshlar()` and `AddAshlarBrick()` 4. **Brick execution**: Direct brick execution through `IBrickExecutor` ### Real Integration - **Octokit** for GitHub API access - **Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting** for DI and configuration - Real async operations with proper cancellation - Error handling for missing resources, rate limits, etc. ## Phase 2: Real-World Testing **Status**: Ready for testing! 🚀 The application is code-complete and ready for validation. See **[TESTING_WORKFLOW.md](pr-blocker-assistant/TESTING_WORKFLOW.md)** for the complete testing guide. ### Testing Plan 1. **Setup** - Build on .NET-capable machine (~15-30 min) 2. **Run 10 assessments** - Mix of open/merged/blocked PRs (~2-3 hours) 3. **Track results** - Use template in [USAGE_LOG.md](pr-blocker-assistant/USAGE_LOG.md) 4. **Analyze** - Measure accuracy, time savings, framework gaps 5. **Report** - Recommendations for Ashlar 0.4.0 ### Quick Start Testing ```bash # First test suggestion - Ashlar PR dotnet run --project src/PrBlocker.CLI -- https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/840 # Or test this PR itself! dotnet run --project src/PrBlocker.CLI -- https://github.com/IanFrelinger/Ashlar/pull/844 ``` ### Success Criteria - ≥90% accuracy in identifying blockers - ≥50% time savings vs manual checking - ≥5 actionable recommendations for Ashlar roadmap ## Relationship to Ashlar Core This application is **separate from Ashlar core**: - Lives in `/pr-blocker-assistant/` (not in `src/`) - Not part of Ashlar solution files - Not included in Ashlar packages or releases - Demonstrates consumer usage patterns - Provides feedback for Ashlar framework improvements ## License Apache 2.0 (same as Ashlar)
